Ring, ring! The bell rang at the little tindahan. Kuya Jose ran to the door. A boy stood there with a coin. "Do you have sari-sari treats?" he asked. Kuya Jose smiled. "Yes, I do. Don't be shy." He gave the boy a sweet, and the boy gave him a coin. Soon more kids came. They looked at the shelves and pointed at the candy. Kuya Jose was busy all morning. When the sun went down, he closed the door and went to bed.
